Metadata.title: Modular Bible | Jorge Doicela
Metadata.description: Exegesis and Bible study platform featuring 8 exegesis and evangelism study tools, Masoretic BHS / LXX morphology, Strong dictionaries, soteriological pathways, and historical context.

Landing.heroSubtitle: Distraction-free reading, deep study in original languages (Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek), interactive biblical maps, timelines, and tools to understand the Holy Scriptures.
Landing.previewVerse1: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Landing.previewVerse2: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
Landing.enginesSubtitle: Discover specialized resources for rigorous, continuous, and accessible study.
Landing.engine1Desc: Read Scripture in a clean, natural format, verse-by-verse or continuous paragraph, with adjustable font size and fonts designed for eye comfort.
Landing.engine2Desc: Compare different Bible translations side-by-side, verse-by-verse, to gain a deeper understanding of nuances and phrasing.
Landing.engine3Desc: Explore Scripture word-by-word in Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek, with direct definitions, pronunciations, and translations.
Landing.engine4Desc: Discover the beauty of Hebrew poetry, the organization of passages, and the theological narrative thread of biblical authors.
Landing.engine5Desc: Look up original definitions and biblical meanings of key terms using trusted reference lexicons and Strong's concordance.
Landing.engine6Desc: Quickly search for any word, theme, or passage across all 66 books of the Bible, with insights into where terms appear most frequently.
Landing.engine7Desc: Locate biblical towns, mountains, and regions on interactive maps, following Paul's journeys and major historical biblical routes.
Landing.engine8Desc: Understand when biblical events took place: kings, prophets, and major world empires presented in chronological order.
Landing.engine9Desc: Discover archaeological findings, ancient manuscripts like the Dead Sea Scrolls, and historical evidence confirming biblical accounts.
Landing.engine10Desc: Structured soteriological pathways (Romans Road, Bridge to Life), biblical answers to apologetic objections, and expository tracts for proclaiming the gospel.
Landing.corpusDesc: Explore landmark textual sources alongside authoritative modern versions, integrated seamlessly for parallel study and morphological analysis.
Landing.corpusV1Desc: The historic, most widely revered translation across the Spanish-speaking church, foundation of classical expository study.
Landing.corpusV1Sample: «Jehová es mi pastor; nada me faltará.»
Landing.corpusV2Desc: Strict, literal word-for-word translation from original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek manuscripts, optimal for close exegesis.
Landing.corpusV2Sample: «El Señor es mi pastor, nada me faltará.»
Landing.corpusV3Desc: Balance of conceptual fidelity, literary beauty, and natural flow for church teaching and public proclamation.
Landing.corpusV3Sample: «El Señor es mi pastor; nada me falta.»
Landing.corpusV4Desc: Crystal-clear, accessible rendering of biblical thought using natural vocabulary of modern Spanish speakers.
Landing.corpusV4Sample: «El Señor es mi pastor; tengo todo lo que necesito.»
Landing.corpusV5Desc: Authoritative transcription of the Codex Leningradensis (1008 A.D.) with cantillation and critical apparatus.
Landing.corpusV6Desc: The ancient Septuagint translation of the Hebrew Scriptures cited extensively by the apostles in the New Testament.
Landing.corpusV6Sample: «Κύριος ποιμαίνει με, καὶ οὐδέν με ὑστερήσει.»
Landing.mobileTitle: Offline Bible Reading (God willing in the future)
Landing.mobileDesc: Designed to go wherever you go without needing an internet connection. Enjoy smooth reading, securely save personal notes and favorites on your device, and receive verse of the day reminders.
Landing.purposeTitle: How would you like to study today?
Landing.purposeHistoryHeadline: Explore the places, timelines, and archaeological heritage of Scripture
Landing.purposeHistoryCard1Desc: Discover harbors, Roman roads, and distances covered by the apostles.
Landing.purposeHistoryCard2Title: Timeline of kings, prophets, and empires
Landing.purposeHistoryCard2Desc: Understand which prophets spoke during each royal reign and world power.
Landing.purposeHistoryCard3Desc: Explore historical evidence and physical artifacts confirming the biblical narrative.
Landing.purposeOriginalsHeadline: Uncover the root meaning behind every translation
Landing.purposeOriginalsCard1Desc: Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek with transliteration, lemma, and direct glosses.
Landing.purposeOriginalsCard2Desc: Complete etymological definitions and biblical concordance frequency.
Landing.purposeOriginalsCard2Meaning: To pasture, feed, tend a flock, guide with tenderness
Landing.purposeOriginalsCard3Desc: Examine frequency and key passages for each original root throughout the biblical canon.
Landing.purposeOriginalsCard3SymC: Theological meaning: Pastoral care of Yahweh
Landing.purposeCompareHeadline: Compare multiple translations verse by verse
Landing.purposeCompareCard1Desc: Examine lexical nuances between formal and thought-for-thought translations.
Landing.purposeCompareCard1V1Text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Landing.purposeCompareCard1V2Text: The LORD is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
Landing.purposeCompareCard2Desc: Instantly notice added words and synonym variations between editions.
Landing.purposeCompareCard2Note: LCS diff algorithm for immediate comparative exegesis.
Landing.purposeCompareCard3Desc: Cross-reference the Hebrew Masoretic Text (BHS) with the Greek Septuagint (LXX).
Landing.purposeDailyCard1Desc: Switch between continuous prose and verse-by-verse, with gentle Serif or Sans fonts.
Landing.purposeDailyCard1Sample: «He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters. He restores my soul...»
Landing.purposeDailyCard1Feature2: Scalable text sizes and optical line height
Landing.purposeDailyCard2Desc: Take study notes saved locally and securely in your browser without signing up.
Landing.purposeDailyCard2VerseContext: Psalm 23:2 • «He leads me beside quiet waters»
Landing.purposeDailyCard2NoteText: Peace does not come from the absence of the valley, but from the presence of the Shepherd. Resting is not inactivity; it is active trust in His direction even in uncertainty.
Landing.purposeDailyCard3Desc: Begin your day with an uplifting scripture passage and historical context.
Landing.purposeDailyCard3Verse: Psalm 23:1 • «The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want»
Landing.purposeDailyCard3Reflection: «True sufficiency is not found in the abundance of possessions, but in the faithfulness of the One who directs your path today.»
Landing.manuscriptsTitle: From Millennial Manuscripts to Your Screen
Landing.manuscriptsDesc: Direct connection to landmark archival sources: Codex Leningradensis (Hebrew Masoretic BHS), the Greek Septuagint (LXX), and the Dead Sea Scrolls.
Landing.manuscriptsItem1Desc: The oldest complete manuscript of the Hebrew Bible, basis for the modern scholarly Masoretic text.
Landing.manuscriptsItem2Desc: The Koine Greek translation of the Old Testament cited widely throughout the New Testament.
Landing.manuscriptsItem3Desc: 3rd-century B.C. manuscripts confirming the extraordinary precision of Scripture preservation.
Landing.step1Desc: Navigate freely among all 66 books of the Bible, from Genesis to Revelation, with no mandatory signup.
Landing.step2Desc: Read in your preferred version or compare verse-by-verse with trusted classic and modern translations.
Landing.step3Title: Go as deep as you want
Landing.step3Desc: Look up Strong's concordance definitions, geographical maps, or historical timelines in a single tap.
Landing.ctaSubtitle: Get instant access to the platform without any mandatory signup or complicated setups.

ExpansionNotice.defaultTitle: A project taking its very first steps
ExpansionNotice.defaultDesc: This platform is entirely new, which is why many parts are still developing. I am building it steadily, with dedication and care in every detail.
ExpansionNotice.encouragementTitle: A word of warm encouragement: Keep walking forward and in God's hands
ExpansionNotice.encouragementP1: I want to wholeheartedly encourage you to keep moving forward in your life, your projects, and your spiritual walk. No matter the hurdles or exhaustion you may feel today, remember that God loves you deeply, His grace sustains you, and each morning brings new mercies to rest in His peace and renewed strength.
ExpansionNotice.encouragementP2: You are warmly welcome in this space. Feel free to explore what is already available, and come back anytime; with God's guidance and over time, I will continue adding many more books and scholarly tools for you.
ExpansionNotice.verseQuote: “I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore with lovingkindness I have drawn you.”
ExpansionNotice.invitationP: I invite you to explore the platform at your own pace and revisit frequently, as new material is continually added.
ExpansionNotice.activeItemsSummaryDefault: Active chapters ready for study: Genesis 1, 2, and 3 across 7 translations.

justification.definition: Sovereign judicial verdict wherein God declares the guilty sinner righteous, imputing the perfect righteousness of Christ through faith.

propitiation.definition: Substitutionary sacrifice that satisfies and fully appeases the holy and righteous wrath of God against sin at the Cross.

grace.definition: The unmerited favor and boundless lovingkindness of God freely granted to rebels deserving of condemnation.

savingFaith.definition: Full surrender and trust of the soul in Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior, resting in His finished redemptive work.

regeneration.definition: The internal spiritual resurrection wrought exclusively by the Holy Spirit, imparting a new heart alive unto God.
